rules: Chinese labels in Seller screenshots are interface translations only; buyer-facing title, description, tags and attribute values remain Russian.
Never use translated Seller UI labels as Ozon API attribute identifiers.
Resolve every attribute ID from the selected live category and type metadata.
Use only field roles that exist in the selected category; never copy this benchmark's IDs to another category.
A content score of 100 does not require every optional field to be filled.
Use source-backed category-specific facts first, workspace defaults second, and omit unsupported optional claims.
Workspace defaults are Нет бренда, country Китай for 1688 sourcing, and quantity 1 when no explicit package quantity exists.
